summary: Fermi Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its issuance of $375M aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031, with the initial purchasers exercising a $56.25M option for total gross proceeds of $431.25M. Net proceeds of ~$416.81M were used partially (~$34.5M) for capped call transactions, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The notes are convertible into cash, stock, or a combination at the company's election. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a convertible debt offering—not a special situation that triggers activist, restructuring, or M&A-event classification. The filing describes standard convertible note terms with no change-of-control, takeover defense, or strategic-review implication.
